title: Running Commentary on Torah 21 — Atika Tamir v-Satim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 21 — עתיקא טמיר וסתים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. 27-segment coarse structure preserves Rabbeinu's own ois-marking (א–יא) plus framing verses (Sifra d-Tzni'usa perek 4 / 'b-ha'aloscha es ha-neiros') and R"N's closing supplement on *chayim nitzchiim*. Torah 21 is the major Breslov teaching on **Atika/Zeir-Anpin, makifim/p-nimi, and the seven candles**, threading: (א) two kinds of sechel (achor=hakdamos vs kedem=shefa Eloki) and hislahavus-lev; (ב) seven openings of face as gateway for panim-sechel; (ג) sukkah=ruach-ha-kodesh=shefa via 7 ananei-kavod; (ד) makif-sechel, y-di'ah-u-v-chirah paradox; (ה) chupah/kiddushin=makif; 7 y-mei mishteh / 7 y-mei aveilus; (ו) chalitzah 'v-yarkah b-panav' = panim-line broken; (ז) crying in tefilah/Torah when mochin are in ibur (70 cries of yoledes); (ח) Yaakov=ibur-state, 'ha-kol kol Yaakov'; (ט) Israel as 'am s-gulah' — supernal phenomenon beyond sechel; (י) revealing s-gulah to am-s-gulah; peirush of Sifra d-Tzni'usa; (יא) 'nachamu nachamu' — chayim nitzchiim via perfected da'as; closing R"N supplement.
